notes:
- orcaInp.newInput(uri?: vscode.Uri): geometryFile = uri?.fsPath ?? (the active editor's document when its extension is .xyz/.inp/.out) ?? undefined; then openStudio(extensionUri, 'inputs', { geometryFile }). Without a file the tab keeps its current geometry.
- onNavigate args (src/studio/tabs/inputs/types.ts InputsNavigateArgs): { geometryFile?, program?: 'orca'|'pyscf', template?: TemplateId, spec?: partial InputSpec merged on top, view?: 'input'|'nea', neaInputs?: string[], neaScript?: 'from_geometry.py'|'from_ensemble.py'|'compare_ensembles.py' }.
- Optional redirect: orcaInp.nea.command (src/features/neaRuns.ts neaCommand) can open openStudio('inputs', { view: 'nea', neaInputs: uris.map(u => u.fsPath) }) instead of the quick picks; the existing command keeps working as is.
- No new settings: the NEA builder reads the existing orcaInp.nea.scriptsDir (already declared in package.json), else searches **/scripts/from_geometry.py.
- Request: a 'studio' method runInTerminal({ command: string, cwd: string, name?: string, execute?: boolean }) implemented in vscodeContext.ts as vscode.window.createTerminal({ name, cwd }).show() + sendText(command, execute ?? false) (dev harness: log only). Then the NEA tab adds 'Send to terminal' (the inputs host method neaCommand already returns { command, cwd }). Until then the tab offers copy only.
- Request: HostContext.activeEditorPath(): string | undefined (last active text editor, any column) so 'Use <file>' can follow the editor without going through orcaInp.newInput.
- Request (UI kit): toast(message, level, action?: { label, run }) for the batch 'Show in Calculations' follow-up; the tab currently shows an inline success callout with that button instead.
- Batch done -> ctx.navigate('calcs', { folder }) with the absolute batch folder; the calcs tab should accept { folder } in onNavigate.
